reason: Both are P&C insurance carriers that underwrite risk and earn premiums plus investment income, selling through independent agents and brokers. AFG focuses on specialty commercial lines for businesses. Kingstone is a regional carrier that mainly writes personal lines (homeowners) for individuals in the Northeast. It also writes some commercial auto, which overlaps with AFG's commercial auto and transportation line. The product overlap is partial, and the customers are mostly different (B2C vs B2B), so this is adjacent.
